Job Details:

Job Description:

The Role and Impact

As a Manufacturing Technician, you will play a critical role in Intel's manufacturing operations by performing essential tasks to ensure production efficiency, product quality, and process optimization. Your core responsibilities will include operating and maintaining production equipment, troubleshooting, and supporting the development and testing of new products and processes. This onsite role is pivotal to delivering high-quality output that meets industry standards and customer specifications.

Business group

The Intel Foundry group is dedicated to delivering world-class manufacturing solutions that drive Intel's leadership in innovation and technology development. This team operates at the intersection of advanced manufacturing and operational efficiency, ensuring high-quality production that powers Intel's products and solutions globally. Joining this group means being part of a dynamic environment that supports Intel's broader mission of technological advancement and market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

- Operate and maintain production equipment to ensure optimal efficiency and output.

- Perform equipment setup, calibration, and adjustments in alignment with standard operating procedures.

- Conduct quality control evaluations and inspections of raw materials and final products to ensure compliance with established standards.

- Participate in the development, testing, and qualification of new products, prototypes, and processes.

- Maintain production logs and documentation as required by standard operating procedures.

- Support the installation, qualification, maintenance, and training for new or reused production equipment.

- Collaborate with peers and management to meet shift output requirements and escalate risks to production schedules as needed.

- Troubleshoot nonstandard events in the production line and drive process improvements.

- Monitor technological health and stability and ensure availability of raw materials.

- Work alongside engineering teams to implement quality and cost improvements.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications

- Practical Engineer in a relevant field with hands-on experience in manufacturing or related domains, demonstrating skills gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.

- Proficiency in operating and troubleshooting production equipment and automated systems.

- Knowledge of manufacturing practices, quality control standards, and process optimization techniques.

- Familiarity with maintaining production documentation and logs.

- The position requires working in shifts.

Preferred Qualifications

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced production environment.

- Effective communication skills to coordinate with peers and management.

- Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new processes, equipment, and technologies.

Job Type:
Tech Grad

Shift:
Shift 9 D (Israel)

Primary Location:
Israel, Kiryat-Gat

Additional Locations:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

N/A

Work Model for this Role
This role will require an on-site presence. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

Competitive Intelligence Analyst - Student

Description -

The Indigo Strategy team is looking for a highly motivated and analytically minded student to support Competitive Intelligence, data analytics and AI-enabled strategy tools. The role sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, markets and data, helping convert information into clear insights and practical tools that support strategic decision-making across HP Indigo.

Key Responsibilities

Competitive & Market Intelligence

· Monitor competitors, markets, technologies and industry developments across HP Indigo businesses.

· Support competitive benchmarking, market assessments, strategic deep dives and recurring CI deliverables.

· Identify relevant market signals, emerging threats and growth opportunities, and translate them into business implications.

· Support the development and automation of monthly competitive updates, alerts and management reports.

Data Analytics & Insights

· Analyze internal and external business and market data to identify trends, patterns, risks and opportunities.

· Support market sizing, market-share analysis, competitor analysis and business-performance reviews.

· Develop dashboards, visualizations and self-service analytical tools using platforms such as Power BI, Excel, Python or SQL.

· Transform complex datasets into clear management insights, recommendations and presentation-ready outputs.

AI & Automation

· Identify opportunities to apply generative AI, AI agents and workflow automation to Strategy and CI activities.

· Build and test AI-enabled solutions for market monitoring, information synthesis, competitive research and reporting.

· Automate repetitive data collection, analysis and reporting processes while maintaining data quality and traceability.

· Experiment with practical ways to combine enterprise data, external information and AI to accelerate strategic insights.

Requirements

· Current B.Sc. or M.Sc. student in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business, or a related analytical field. Minimum 2 years remaining of studies.

· Strong analytical thinking and business curiosity, with the ability to connect data and market information to business meaning.

· Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with Power BI, Python, SQL or data-visualization tools is an advantage.

· Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools, large language models, AI agents, prompt engineering or workflow automation is a strong advantage.

· Ability to independently research a topic, structure findings and communicate a clear conclusion.

· Strong written and verbal English.

· Proactive, collaborative and fast-learning, with a hands-on build-and-experiment mindset.

What We Offer

· Exposure to real strategic and management decisions in a global technology business.

· Hands-on experience across competitive intelligence, corporate strategy and business analytics.

· An opportunity to develop and deploy AI-enabled tools with real users and measurable business impact.

· Collaboration with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across Indigo and PSBD.

· A distinctive learning experience combining strategy, data, AI and business.
